newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Celtech details 5,9 million rand cash issue.
newsitem.headline: Celtech details 5,9 million rand cash issue.

text.p: Newly-listed Celtron Technologies Ltd said on Wednesday it would issue 5.9 million shares of no par value at the start of trade today.
It said the issue was a result of the sale of 5.9 million shares at 175 cents each to New Africa Investments Ltd on February 10 by way of a shares for cash transaction.
Celtron said the shares for cash issue would serve to strengthen the company's capital base and bring a strategic partner into its shareholding.
The listing of the units had been approved by the Johannesburg Stock Exchange, it said.
Undiluted earnings per share for the year to end September were now forecast at 14.72 cents to take into account the new issue from 13.04 cents.
The company was listed on the bourse on February 12.
